g.text: Nonredundant representatives; all have BH FDR < 0.05
U1-U2: upstream context; D1-D2: minimum downstream steps
All model edges among displayed nodes are retained
Display threshold >=1/2 is a coverage choice, not a significance cutoff
D2 paths to all 10 observed self-excluded query hits
Thick black border: mitochondrial query hit at >=1/2
Node size and x/2 show neighborhood recurrence
U1-U2 nodes are upstream context; D1-D2 nodes lie downstream; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
